summary: Both stage-2 asks answered and taken in: Graffiti's face is the spree corridor (his lean, OWNER:1794728091811038301), and a raider faction's standing mark brings its next raid sooner or larger, announced by a letter (by card, OWNER:1794728164229812842, chosen over the recommended aim). Designer's undoable reading: the letter names the faction and its mark so the pressure is traceable to the wall; scrubbing or weathering the last mark lifts it; sooner/larger and size are Mod Settings tuning. No ask sent, no core contradiction open; proof-home and site-settings script gaps go to stage 3.
